New episodes of 9to5Mac Daily are recorded every weekday. Subscribe to our podcast on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast player to make sure new episodes are delivered straight to your ears as soon as they're released.

In this episode we discuss:

  • Apple announces price increases for Apple TV and Apple One subscriptions
  • iPhone 18 Pro pre-orders may start slightly later than usual
  • Report: Apple Watch Series 12 could feature always-on heart rate monitoring and a new Fitness app
